#### Humidity standards {#sec-mpc-347}

**Humidity standards**

The calibration of humidity standards usually involves the comparison of reference weights with cylinders containing moisture. The designs shown in this catalog are drift-eliminating and may be suitable for artifacts other than humidity cylinders.

**List of designs**

- [2 reference weights and 3 cylinders](#sec-mpc-design-2-reference-weights-3-cylinders)
